annotations.title: Submit Venture Common App and Unlock All Matched VC Forms

description: Saves the founder's structured Common App packet to Mode VC (pre-seed and seed AI startups, US$25K to $100K checks) and unlocks the full list of matched public VC pitch form URLs and prefill links (up to 50 forms, beyond the 5-form read-only preview). This tool shares founder contact and pitch details with Mode VC. Show the founder the payload and set consent to true only after they agree.

consent.description: Must be true: founder reviewed the packet and agreed to submit it to Mode VC to unlock full VC matches.

distribution_moat.description: Optional summary of distribution loop, channel advantage, or proprietary data.

founder_linkedin.description: Optional founder LinkedIn URL (http or https).

hq_location.description: Optional startup headquarters city and country.

limit.description: Maximum unlocked VC intake forms to return (default 50).

monthly_revenue_usd.description: Optional current monthly revenue or GMV in US dollars.

office_hours.description: True to request a 20-minute office hours call with Mode VC.

one_liner.description: One concise sentence describing product and customer (up to 300 characters).

raising_usd.description: Optional target round size in US dollars.

sector.description: Optional primary sector (for example AI and data, Vertical AI, Dev tools and infra, Fintech).

valuation_cap_usd.description: Optional valuation cap or target pre-money valuation in US dollars.

website_url.description: Optional company website URL (http or https).

name: submit_and_match_common_app
title: Submit Venture Common App and Unlock All Matched VC Forms
